title: Spirit Animals
blurb: Sloths, magpies and honey badgers: which creature is each of you really?

prompts: Most likely to nap like a cat in whichever patch of sun they can find
Most likely to hoard snacks like a squirrel before winter
Most likely to get swooped by a magpie and take it very personally
Most likely to sleep through anything like a sloth
Most likely to stalk the biscuit tin like a cat stalks a mouse
Most likely to shake with excitement when they hear the word "walkies"
Most likely to collect shiny things like a bowerbird with a blue bottle cap
Most likely to make a nest of blankets and refuse to leave it
Most likely to ignore every warning like a honey badger
Most likely to smell a pie from three streets away like a bloodhound
Most likely to befriend every dog they pass in the park
Most likely to wake the whole house at dawn like a rooster
Most likely to act cool in public while furiously paddling underneath like a duck
Most likely to walk around the whole zoo just to see the capybara
Most likely to fall in love with a quokka and move to Rottnest
Most likely to adopt a stray cat and call it "the roommate"
Most likely to cry when watching a nature documentary about penguins
Most likely to try to pet every kangaroo they see
Most likely to put on a full show for the flock like a peacock
Most likely to migrate to the beach every summer like a seagull
Most likely to work out what the lorikeets are shouting about
Most likely to stare out of a window all day like an old tabby
Most likely to befriend a crow and feed it every morning
Most likely to bring home a pet that is far too big for the flat
Most likely to spend a weekend in a bird hide with binoculars and a thermos
Most likely to spend a day at the aquarium with a pass for every tank
Most likely to dive in like a pelican to grab a stray chip
Most likely to become best friends with a goat on a farm stay
Most likely to make a squeaky noise when excited like a hamster in a wheel
Most likely to name every spider that lives in the house
Most likely to sleep curled up in the exact shape of a dog
Most likely to watch ants at a picnic like it's a primetime series
Most likely to follow a friend everywhere like a duckling
Most likely to howl at the moon at a party for no reason
Most likely to raise a tadpole in the back garden and name it
Most likely to feed a baby bird with a tiny dropper and cry when it flies off
Most likely to spend their savings on a rare fish
Most likely to take a hundred photos of a sleepy possum
Most likely to know the birdsong of every garden visitor
Most likely to stand perfectly still like a heron waiting for chips
Most likely to build a cubby like a beaver and refuse to share
